title: David and Goliath
summary: David faced Goliath when Israel's army was afraid. David trusted the Lord, remembered how God had helped him before, and defeated the giant.

read_it.prompt: Read how David listened, trusted God, and stepped forward when everyone else was afraid.

tell_it: Goliath was a huge soldier who scared Israel's army. David was young, but he knew God was stronger than any giant. David did not trust armor or size. He trusted the Lord and used a sling and a stone.
understand_it: This passage teaches that God's people can trust Him when they face frightening things. Courage is not pretending nothing is scary. Courage is doing the right thing because God is faithful.
age_5_7_explanation: David was small, but God is bigger than giants. David trusted God when he was afraid.
age_8_11_explanation: David trusted God instead of trusting armor, weapons, or size. Courage comes from faith, not from being the biggest person in the room.
teen_explanation: David had already learned to trust God while protecting sheep. Faith often grows through smaller challenges before bigger ones, and courage means acting from trust in God.
key_truths: God is stronger than the things that scare us.
Faith helps us obey when a hard thing is in front of us.
God can use young people who trust Him.
life_application: If someone at school is being picked on, courage may mean asking for help, speaking kindly, or refusing to join in. You do not need to be the loudest person to do the right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Why was David brave enough to face Goliath?
quiz_questions.explanation: David remembered that God had helped him before and believed God was stronger than Goliath.

quiz_questions.question: David defeated Goliath by trusting God, not by copying Saul's armor.
quiz_questions.explanation: David tried the armor but did not use it. He went with the tools he knew and trusted the Lord.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember that the battle belongs to the Lord.

discussion_questions: What had David learned before he faced Goliath?
What is one hard thing where you can ask God for courage?

activity.title: Five Smooth Stones
activity.instructions: Draw five stones. On each stone, write one way God helps His people: courage, wisdom, help, truth, and faith.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me trust You when I feel small or afraid. Give me courage to do what is right.
